lookup_khot_embedding_by_atomic_number: lookup the k-hot embedding vector for a given atomic number from the KHOT_EMBEDDINGS dictionary
inspect_khot_embedding_dimensions: inspect the dimensionality of k-hot elemental embeddings by checking the length of any entry in KHOT_EMBEDDINGS
iterate_all_khot_embeddings: iterate over all 100 k-hot elemental embeddings in the KHOT_EMBEDDINGS dictionary keyed by atomic number
convert_khot_to_tensor: convert a k-hot embedding list from KHOT_EMBEDDINGS into a PyTorch tensor for use in a CGCNN model
compare_khot_embeddings: compare two k-hot elemental embeddings by atomic number to find shared and differing feature bits
